decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of conditions SuDS (3), rooflights (4), external materials (5) and brickwork (6) of planning permission ref: 26/00672/HOU as the proposal lacks sufficient drainage plan as well as unacceptable external materials and finishes related to the proposed roof lights, brickworks and roof tiles. The proposal is therefore contrary to Chapter 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies D4, HC1 of the London Plan (2024), CP30 and CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and DMD8, DMD37 and DMD44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
